node.statement: For every j, let d_j:=dim(L_j), fix an orthonormal basis (e_j[k])_{0 <= k < d_j}, put Sigma_j:={0,...,d_j-1}^2, and for s=(a,b) in Sigma_j define U_js e_j[k]:=exp(2*pi*i*a*k/d_j)e_j[(k+b) mod d_j] and p_js:=d_j^(-2); then every U_js is unitary, p_js >= 0, sum_{s in Sigma_j}p_js=1, and for every Z in B(L_j tensor E_j), sum_{s in Sigma_j}p_js*(U_js^* tensor I_Ej)Z(U_js tensor I_Ej)=I_Lj tensor (Tr_Lj(Z)/d_j), where Tr_Lj denotes the unnormalized partial trace over L_j; this twirl is a positive order-preserving contraction onto I_Lj tensor B(E_j).
